description: This PHP class 'ConvertUOM' provides unit of measure conversions, including categories, unit details, multipliers, and a main CONVERT function for converting values between different measurement units, with support for temperature conversions and array inputs.

classes.name: ConvertUOM
classes.description: A class for converting units of measure across various categories, supporting temperature conversions and array inputs.

methods.name: getConversionCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of all conversion categories available.

methods.name: getConversionCategoryUnits
methods.description: Returns units of measure for a specified category or all categories.

methods.name: getConversionCategoryUnitDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed info (unit and description) for units in a specified category.

methods.name: getConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns standard metric multipliers for unit conversions.

methods.name: getBinaryConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns binary multipliers for information units.

methods.name: CONVERT
methods.description: Main function to convert a value from one unit of measure to another, supporting arrays and temperature conversions.

methods.name: getUOMDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details (category, multiplier) for a given unit of measure, handling prefixes.

methods.name: convertTemperature
methods.description: Converts temperature values between different temperature units.

methods.name: resolveTemperatureSynonyms
methods.description: Resolves synonyms for temperature units to standard symbols.
